#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

ll solve(ll r, ll c) {
    if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0;
    if (r == 1) {
        ll res = c;
        ll m = c % 6;
        if (m != 0) {
            if (m <= 3) res -= m;
            if (m == 4) res -= 2;
            if (m == 5) res -= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    if (r == 2) {
        if (c == 3 || c == 7) return r * (c - 1);
        return r * c;
    }
    ll res = r * c;
    if (res % 2 == 0) return res;
    return res - 1;
}

int main() {
    ll R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    ll ans = solve(min(R, C), max(R, C));
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
